thread:
marta: Heads up — Azure approved part of our quota request for NDv2 in eastus2 but NCv3 is still blocked due to subnet port limits. I'm opening a combined quota+networking ticket so support has the full picture.

alex: thanks. can you paste the support ticket id when you have it? also we should flag this for capacity reservation windows (we need 8x ND40rs for the 04/01 deploy).

marta: ticket created: 120345678. I added the deployment window and linked subscription IDs. Azure responded with a follow-up asking which subnet and which NSG rules need port limit increases.

sam: pinging infra-oncall — @priya are you around to pair with Azure so we can unblock NCs? NCs are what the benchmarking team needs for multi-card perf tests.

priya: yep i'm here. Marta — which subnet? i'll pull the NSG and subnet delegation details.

marta: it's `prod-gpu-subnet` in rg-inference-eastus2. current /26, we hit IP limit + port-per-socket dynamic limit. Azure notes a per-subnet port allocation for accelerated networking that needs approval.

alex: if Azure stalls on subnet size increase, fallback plan is to move some workloads to westus2 or reserve dedicated NDv2 capacity instead of NC. That will increase cross-region egress cost though.

sam: can you paste the CLI checks you ran? i'll attach to the ticket.

marta: pasted below:
```bash
az vm list-usage --location eastus2 --query "[?name.value=='standardNC']}"
az network vnet subnet show --name prod-gpu-subnet --resource-group rg-inference-eastus2
```

priya: grabbing NSG rules now. looks like ephemeral port exhaustion is hitting `50000-60000` range on the subnet outbound. We should ask Azure to bump the per-socket allocation or increase subnet prefix to /24.

azure-support-bot: Support ticket 120345678: Acknowledged, engineering review started. Estimated response 48 hours. Reference escalation INC-9876 if urgent.

alex: 48h is long — marking as P1 for the weekend launch. Marta please request immediate engineering escalation and include a diagram of which VMs need accel networking.

marta: escalated with notes + diagram attached. Also requested temporary port reallocation while they approve bigger subnet.

sam: also ask them to whitelist our subscription pair in their quota backend — we've seen quota accidentally attach to the wrong subscription before (remember 1755012345 incident).

priya: FYI I ran a quick failover test: spun up 2 NC instances in westus2 and validated the model load. Perf was ~6% worse but usable. We can stage there if eastus2 doesn't clear.

deploy-bot: Deploy window reminder: canary rollout scheduled 2026-04-01T04:00Z — rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m pauses.

marta: cost estimate if we move 8 nodes to westus2 for 2 weeks: ~$22k extra (GPU egress + regional price diff). Adding to ticket.

azure-support-bot: Update on 120345678: Engineering requested subnet id and NSG name. Please run: `az network vnet subnet list --resource-group rg-inference-eastus2 --vnet-name prod-vnet` and attach output.

marta: done — attached output to the ticket. Requested both subnet / prefix increase and temporary port reassign.

alex: great. if we don't hear back by EOD tomorrow, we'll schedule a short maintenance to shift canary to westus2. Marta, coordinate with product for the change window.

sam: added runbook note: if we shift region, ensure KV and model artifact sync completes prior to canary start. I'll draft the checklist.

priya: once azure confirms, i'll validate NSG and run a small smoke test (1 job) and report latency.

marta: thanks everyone. i'll post updates in this thread and paste the final support response. :thumbsup:
